field_semantics.bos20_up: current close above the prior 20-bar high; scored field, distinct from structural bos_up
field_semantics.choch_rule_up: three latest confirmed swing lows strictly ascending plus a green current candle; scored field, distinct from structural choch_up
field_semantics.structural_events: bos_up and choch_up are separate swing-structure events and are not the scored 30/20 point fields
field_semantics.bullish_ob: on structural BOS-up, scan from the last confirmed swing-low index to the BOS bar; a qualifying candle is bearish with range >=0.3%; current close below its lower boundary invalidates it; within5 is distance to the zone <=$5
field_semantics.fvg: the current implementation tracks the most recent bullish gap and marks a refill when the current bar range intersects it within 48 bars

code_review_findings: The OB tuple stores both BOS confirmation index and origin candle index, but bull_ob_age_bars is calculated from the BOS confirmation index; candidate traces should report origin age separately without changing the existing validity rule.

The OB selection loop overwrites the candidate for each qualifying bearish candle in the swing-low-to-BOS interval, leaving the last qualifying candle; record all candidates and the selected one before considering any behavior change.
The FVG state stores only the most recent bullish gap; trace its origin, zone, age, first refill and mitigation at each signal bar.
The pivot price list records confirmed prices but not explicit confirmation timestamps in the diagnostic output; trace pivot origin and confirmation bars to prove no lookahead.
Current report counts components marginally, not their same-closed-bar intersection; do not claim the OB is the sole cause from the 1/34 marginal count.
causal_conclusion: No candidate-level causal trace has been emitted yet. The maximum score of 75 proves at least one of the four required components was absent on each Wave3 trigger; marginal component counts do not identify the unique blocker.
next_required: Emit one row per Wave3 trigger with signal timestamp/index and same-bar BOS20, structural BOS/CHoCH, choch_rule_up, OB origin/zone/range/distance/invalidation, and FVG origin/zone/age/refill/mitigation.
Record pivot index and confirmation index for the three higher lows.
Add no-lookahead tests for pivots, OB invalidation, and FVG creation/refill.
